topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining the learning objectives and setting the framework for understanding cancer evolution and microenvironmental interactions.

topics.label: Clonal Evolution and Epigenetic Plasticity in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer develops through the evolutionary selection of driver mutations and non-mutational epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how stem cell hierarchies, cellular differentiation states, and cancer stem cell properties influence tumor initiation across different cancer types.

topics.label: Tumor Microenvironment, Inflammation, and Coevolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how interactions with the surrounding microenvironment and inflammatory signals drive cancer progression and shape tumor coevolution.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
